polaris: executable transition oracle: P0-P8 predicates must return expected statuses for null/current/context-only/exact-complete/mismatch/mode-promotion payloads.

input_boundary.academic_search: No paper search was needed; this round is a mechanical oracle over existing P0-P8 predicates.

framework.name: validator-facing transition oracle for proof-carrying O_s admission
framework.cross_domain_jump: runtime admission tests plus typed proof propositions
framework.core_rule: expected_status(case) is determined by the first target-mode predicate in P0-P8 that is missing, false, or mismatched; only exact-complete payloads with all P0-P6 checks true may reach ADMITTED_EXACT.
framework.current_exact_rule: The current exact O_s claim remains BLOCK because the consumed inputs do not supply the exact-mode proof object set required by P6.
framework.reported_context_rule: reported_context can PASS only when source_bibliographic_id and stable_source_locator are present and the claim scope is limited to source-reported context; it cannot upgrade to exact O_s.

changes_from_round2.change: Converted the Round 2 predicate table into a transition oracle with explicit case_id, current_mode, target_mode, proof_objects_present, expected_status, first_failed_predicate, and why_no_silent_upgrade columns.

Separated null, scalar-only, current, context-only, exact-complete, diagnosed-mismatch, and forbidden mode-promotion cases so a future validator can compare actual executor output against expected results.
Made the current state executable: current-to-context is BLOCK without stable_source_locator, and current-to-exact is BLOCK because P1-P6 exact proof objects are not supplied.
Preserved Round 2's key repair: locator-gated context PASS is allowed only for reported_context and never implies exact O_s.

transition_oracle_summary.null_cases: No proof objects return BLOCK at P0 because neither bibliographic identity nor stable locator exists.
transition_oracle_summary.current_cases: Current evidence is treated as scalar/bibliography without stable locator in the consumed inputs; it is BLOCK for context PASS and BLOCK for exact O_s.
transition_oracle_summary.context_only_cases: A stable locator can yield CONDITIONAL_CONTEXT_PASS for reported_context only; exact target mode fails first at missing structure-bound predicates.
transition_oracle_summary.exact_complete_cases: A payload with locator, structure identity, same-structure mapping, pair policy, pair enumerator/list, N_pair, raw sum, normalization, constants, tolerance, executor trace, digests, and verifier version returns ADMITTED_EXACT.
transition_oracle_summary.mismatch_cases: If any target predicate is false, the oracle returns DIAGNOSED_MISMATCH at the first failed predicate even when later fields are present.
transition_oracle_summary.mode_promotion_cases: P8 blocks promotion by numeric closeness, narrative provenance, bibliographic familiarity, generic provenance hygiene, or executor quality unless target-mode proof predicates are satisfied.

expected_results.expected: BLOCK for context PASS because stable_source_locator is absent; exact O_s also remains BLOCK under P6.
CONDITIONAL_CONTEXT_PASS for reported_context only; BLOCK for exact_certified_observable.
BLOCK at the first missing target-mode predicate.
ADMITTED_EXACT only when P0-P6 all pass and P8 authorizes the target transition.
DIAGNOSED_MISMATCH at the first failed predicate; later evidence cannot mask the failure.

claims.statement: P0-P8 can be executed as a transition oracle by mapping payload families to expected statuses and first failed predicates.
equations: expected_status := PASS_target if all target predicates pass else status(first_failed_predicate)
first_failed_predicate := min_ordered(P0..P8 where required object missing or check false)
references: PI Round 2 request for null/current/future-complete expected statuses
assumptions: A future validator preserves P0-P8 order for first-failure reporting.
The oracle tests admission status, not material truth.

claims.statement: The current exact O_s state is BLOCK; the only possible PASS in this oracle below exact mode is locator-gated reported_context.
assumptions: The consumed current inputs do not include a stable row/page/table locator plus full exact proof objects.

claims.statement: Silent upgrades are mechanically rejectable: numeric closeness, narrative provenance, bibliographic familiarity, generic provenance hygiene, or executor quality are not transition witnesses unless target predicates pass.
equations: upgrade_allowed(current_mode,target_mode) := required_fields(target_mode) subset payload and all_checks(target_mode) = true
numeric_closeness_only or narrative_provenance_only or executor_quality_only => P8_BLOCK
assumptions: The validator distinguishes extra narrative fields from proof objects required by the target mode.

deepening_1.question: What deeper structure appears when P0-P8 are converted from predicates into expected transition results?

layer_1.structure: short-circuit evaluator over an ordered predicate chain
layer_1.mapping: The oracle records the first predicate that prevents target admission. This turns a narrative failure into a deterministic diagnostic state.
layer_1.consequence: BLOCK is not vague: it is located at P0, P1, P2, P3, P4, P5, P6, or P8.

layer_2.mapping: Each mode proves a different proposition: reported_context proves source reporting; exact_certified_observable proves a full computed observable identity.
layer_2.consequence: A proof object for one proposition cannot be silently reused as a proof object for another.

deepening_2.question: What next-layer extension from runtime admission control maps back to O_s?

layer_1.source_extension: negative test fixtures are part of the certificate system
layer_1.mapping: Null, current, mismatch, and mode-promotion cases are as important as exact-complete cases because they prove the gate rejects invalid transitions.
layer_1.consequence: The oracle can catch regressions where a validator accidentally treats provenance as exactness.

layer_2.mapping: Each DIAGNOSED_MISMATCH case is a counterexample to exact O_s with a named failed predicate, not a general claim that exact O_s is impossible.
layer_2.consequence: Future work can repair the failed proof object without weakening the terminal exactness rule.
